'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Conrad Simmering DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Conrad Simmering]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Spice Mine Operations|VB7-D-spicemineoperations-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
